# Verify: for f(z) = (1+i)z + 1, which n makes f^n a reflection (point reflection) about z0 = i?
# Exact Gaussian-integer arithmetic. f^n(z) = a_n * z + b_n, with (a, b) stored as Gaussian integers.

def mul(p, q):
    return (p[0] * q[0] - p[1] * q[1], p[0] * q[1] + p[1] * q[0])

def add(p, q):
    return (p[0] + q[0], p[1] + q[1])

def compose(F, G):
    # returns F(G(z)) where F(z) = a z + b and G(z) = c z + d
    a, b = F
    c, d = G
    return (mul(a, c), add(mul(a, d), b))

def apply(F, z):
    a, b = F
    return add(mul(a, z), b)

def norm2(p):
